stem: Meena watches rain water collect in the pond near her school in Jaipur. Her teacher asks the class to put the stages of the water cycle in the correct order, starting from the Sun heating the water. Which sequence is correct?

options.text: Evaporation and transpiration → rising and cooling of water vapour → condensation into clouds → precipitation → seepage and return flow to water bodies
Condensation into clouds → evaporation and transpiration → precipitation → rising and cooling of water vapour → seepage and return flow to water bodies
Precipitation → condensation into clouds → seepage and return flow → evaporation and transpiration → rising and cooling of water vapour
Rising and cooling of water vapour → precipitation → evaporation and transpiration → condensation into clouds → seepage and return flow to water bodies

teacher.key_rationale: The water cycle begins with Sun-driven evaporation and transpiration, followed by rising and cooling of vapour, condensation into clouds, precipitation, then seepage/return flow to water bodies. Only option A gives this order; B, C and D start at later stages.
